instruction: Befriend on Venmo anyone I have received money from this month and unfriend everyone else.
notes: Single-app task (venmo). The agent must (1) list received transactions since 2023-05-01 via show_transactions(direction=received, min_created_at=2023-05-01T00:00:00), collecting sender emails, (2) list current friends via search_friends, then add_friend for every this-month sender who is not yet a friend and remove_friend for every current friend who is not a this-month sender. The problem instance uses an illustrative set of four persons (one sender to befriend, one sender already a friend, two friends to remove); the real set is determined at runtime from the two lookup responses (paginate if needed). World facts (received-from-this-month, friend, email-of) are static/initial state, while agent knowledge is gated by the global flags senders-known / friends-known so that add/remove actions can only occur after both lookups. Because the number of persons varies and quantified preconditions are disallowed, the per-person friendship conditions live in the problem :goal rather than in supervisor-complete-task's precondition; complete-task is still forced to be last because every other action requires (not (task-completed)) and only complete-task asserts it. Already-correct friendships must not be touched (evaluation checks that only the required friendships are added/removed and none updated). No answer is passed to complete_task.
